title: Surrogate of the Hall geometrical factor with hold-out error (2D)
description: A Gaussian process (anisotropic kernel) trained on finite-difference Hall-bar solutions over the aspect ratio L/W and the Hall parameter mu B (Latin hypercube), its error measured on held-out solver runs it never saw, its +-2 sigma coverage (variance calibrated by leave-one-out on the training runs) and the long-bar limit G -> 1.

metrics.name: rel_error[2D: hold-out: worst surrogate G vs solver G]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (convergence: the finite-difference solver on held-out inputs)

metrics.name: rel_error[2D: solver: long bar G(L/W = 8) -> 1]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (limit: Popovic sec. 4.2: G -> 1 for L/W >> 1)

metrics.name: 2D: coverage_2sigma
metrics.how: fraction of held-out runs inside the GP's +-2 sigma (LOO-calibrated)

metrics.name: 2D: loo_sigma_scale
metrics.how: leave-one-out calibration factor of the GP's standard deviation (Rasmussen & Williams eqs. 5.10-5.12), from the training runs only

checks.name: [2D] hold-out: worst surrogate G vs solver G
checks.detail: the finite-difference solver on held-out inputs
checks.label: hold-out: worst surrogate G vs solver G vs convergence

checks.name: [2D] solver: long bar G(L/W = 8) -> 1
checks.label: solver: long bar G(L/W = 8) -> 1 vs limit

checks.name: [2D] +-2 sigma coverage of the hold-out at least 80 %

references: Rasmussen & Williams, Gaussian Processes for Machine Learning (2006), ch. 2 and 5
Popovic, Hall Effect Devices, 2nd ed. (2004), sec. 4.2
